content: better-sqlite3 is the standard sync, high-performance SQLite driver for Node.js server-side apps and works well with Electron/Tauri sidecar processes; node:sqlite is Node 22+'s built-in module (still experimental, similar sync API) reducing native-module friction; sql.js compiles SQLite to WASM for browser/in-memory use without persistence. For a local-first desktop-bound app, better-sqlite3 (or its encrypted fork) is the 2025/2026 default choice.
